essence: A healthy cow adorned with golden horns and silver hooves is the prescribed gift.
The ritual space must follow the prior model with an altar and a maṇḍala.
The rite may be performed either as a Rudra-gift or as a Sun-gift.
One should arrange a five-limbed ornament valued at five niṣkas.
Both the dakṣiṇā and any unstated details should conform to the earlier prescription.
